indexConvention: rowIndex is zero-based; rowNumber is one-based
scope: 15 assigned UI rows; reveal/capability, title earning and life-loop rows belong to sibling lanes

rows.heading: 1. Recipes
rows.mechanism: Recipe view puts list, reagents, output and tools side by side; unknown ingredients show as ???; missing requirements are colored.
rows.reason: Existing crafting detail uses itemRecipeStatus for preview, blocking, commit and truthful receipt; native item-recipe list sits beside the detail.

rows.heading: 2. Vendors and shops
rows.mechanism: Shop rows color the price red when unaffordable and gray when sold out, keeping quantity, price and bulk controls on one row.
rows.reason: Incremental affordability includes current basket and sales. Status words accompany --sem-blocked; sold-out known rows stay gray and disabled for the trade visit. All-in-basket is distinct from sold out.

rows.heading: 4. Combat
rows.mechanism: Combat messages have a grammar: damage-type color, CRIT text, body-part suffix and a condensed multi-hit count line.
rows.reason: Original native formatter: physical type marker, gain/loss colors, explicit CRIT and one total with ×N hits. Native combat has no body-part targeting; no fictitious body-part suffix or new mechanics added.

rows.heading: 5. UI builders and state plumbing
rows.mechanism: Newly acquired inventory items blink until seen.
rows.reason: Existing session-only new-item marker clears on hover or focus; not reimplemented.

rows.heading: 5. UI builders and state plumbing
rows.mechanism: Log freezes on request but then drops new messages; otherwise forces scroll to bottom.
rows.reason: Existing reading position and unread control retain appended receipts; not reimplemented.

rows.heading: F2: Colors, VFX, spacing and detailed states
rows.mechanism: P2 per-region gradients and colored quantities/events with consistent semantic meanings.
rows.reason: Existing Vivid default respects stored Standard, semantic purchase colors and player appearance preferences.

rows.heading: F2: Colors, VFX, spacing and detailed states
rows.mechanism: P3 effects: panel appear ramp, coin floating text on spend, new-item blink.
rows.reason: Existing bounded panel arrival ramp, anchored coin float and new-item marker; Effects off/reduced motion retained. Native reveal uses tint/brightness rather than concealing information with opacity.

rows.heading: F2: Colors, VFX, spacing and detailed states
rows.mechanism: P4 tight data rows with thin separators, ~30 px action rows, compact place header, dedicated log scroller.
rows.reason: Existing workspace density, dedicated log scroller and aligned vitals retained.

rows.heading: F2: Colors, VFX, spacing and detailed states
rows.mechanism: P5 unknown recipe ingredients shown as ???, colored requirements, restored settings/log labels.
rows.reason: Existing Unfamiliar material placeholder is the native equivalent of ???; missing quantities and reasons use the blocked token without leaking ingredient identity.

rows.heading: First playable slice and remaining gate
rows.mechanism: Proposed first slice: one discovery-aware reveal, a vivid semantic palette and short reveal feedback, checked at three desktop viewports.
rows.reason: Existing first-slice gate rechecked at 1366×768, 1440×900 and 1920×1080. Discovery implementation remains owned by reveal-chain.

rows.heading: F5: Colors and effects form several distinct vocabularies
rows.mechanism: Separate color vocabularies: item subtype in inventory, rarity on equipped gear, red/gray in shops, damage type in combat, weather glyphs in place header.
rows.reason: Existing rarityColor palette stays separate from subtype, money and weather colors. New vendor and physical-hit state colors do not recolor item rarity.

rows.heading: F6: Dense UI works because details have a nearby place to go
rows.mechanism: List beside detail: recipe list next to reagents/output/tools, enemy beside player above actions, shop rows with quantity, price and bulk controls.
rows.reason: Existing selectable recipe list/detail, keyboard selection, persistent scroll/focus and side/below preference verified; no replacement UI.

rows.heading: F6: Dense UI works because details have a nearby place to go
rows.mechanism: Keyboard handling exists but inventory focus is assigned only on mouse hover.
rows.reason: All inventory/worn rows and equipment slots focusable. Same read-only tooltip on focus, with viewport-clamped position and aria-describedby; details refresh with inventory updates.

rows.heading: F7: Preserve strong behavior while correcting source coupling
rows.mechanism: Log freeze drops new receipts instead of retaining them.
rows.reason: Duplicate log reading/retention mapping for row 52; existing implementation verified.

rows.heading: F8: Current adoption map, checked against live source
rows.mechanism: Titles panel shows unearned goals; equipment condition and weather consequences need exact presentation.
rows.reason: Exact worn-instance condition and owner repair quote update after hits; optional weather header shows effective temperature, duration and actual outdoor weather XP factor. Existing Titles goal presentation retained; no title logic changed.
